authority: Curated mapping from the Crystal Warden AI-GOV controls to NIST AI RMF 1.0 subcategories (subcategory ids from the NIST AI RMF, sourced by agy). The four AI-GOV families are built ON the AI RMF functions (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage), so the function alignment is by design; the specific subcategory assignments are curated and should be verified against the NIST AI RMF Playbook. A subcategory is reported met only when every mapped AI-GOV control is met (fail closed).
